transcript: Your therapist will never tell you these three things. But I will. You are not broken. You are not weak. And you are not just anxious or depressed. Your body has been living in survival for too long. For years, maybe your whole life, your nervous system has been stuck in fight or flight. Always alert, always tense, always waiting. So what you call anxiety is your body trying to protect you. What you call depression is your body shutting down after being overwhelmed for too long. Listen carefully. You don't heal this by thinking more. You don't heal this by analyzing your past again and again. You heal this by coming back to the body, by teaching your system that it is safe again, by slowing down, breathing deeper, feeling instead of escaping. Most people try to fix the mind while the body is still in war. That is why nothing changes. Peace is not found in more noise. It is found in stillness. If this spoke to you, follow me. I share how to reset your nervous system and find real calm again. And if you're ready to go deeper, my guide, The Way Back to Stillness, is waiting for you in the link in my profile.
